results.content: # Characteristics and Evolutionary Patterns of Carbon Emission Efficiency in the Construction Industry: An Empirical Study in Southeast Coastal City Cluster in China. Clarifying the change characteristics and cyclical evolution rules of carbon emission efficiency in the construction industry (CEECI) is profoundly significant for formulating regionally differentiated policies and promoting cross-regional collaborative efforts towards emission reduction. Focusing on the Guangdong-Fujian-Zhejiang coastal urban agglomeration (GFZ-CUA), this paper utilizes the data envelopment analysis model to investigate the static distribution characteristics, introduces Malmquist index model to assess dynamic evolution patterns in CEECI, and proposes the cooperative carbon reduction strategies. (3) The carbon emission efficiency and efficiency changes of the construction industry in each city exhibit different static-dynamic characteristics, and the cities are classified into four development modes: stable, rounding, gradual and mutating, based on their development paths.
